title: Stealing profits: Spread-based temporal hierarchy forecasting for day-ahead electricity markets
abstract: arXiv:2609.23223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Day-ahead electricity price forecasts support trading and storage decisions, but for battery arbitrage predicting intraday price spreads is more relevant than predicting individual hourly prices. Here we show that a temporal hierarchy forecasting (THieF) framework that jointly reconciles forecasts of hourly electricity prices and all intraday price spreads consistently improves performance across two major European electricity markets and three different forecasting architectures. Using five years of out-of-sample data from Germany and Spain, we obtain accuracy improvements of up to 19.7% and profit gains of up to 10.4% relative to unreconciled hourly price forecasts. The gains persist even for a highly accurate pretrained TabPFN foundation model. translated_title: 窃取利润：面向日前电力市场的基于价差的时间层级预测
translated_abstract: 日前电价预测为交易和储能决策提供支持，但对于电池套利而言，预测日内价差比预测单个小时价格更为重要。本文表明，一种时间层级预测（THieF）框架通过联合协调小时电价预测与所有日内价差预测，在两个主要欧洲电力市场和三种不同预测架构上均能持续提升性能。基于德国和西班牙五年的样本外数据，相对于未协调的小时电价预测，我们获得了高达19.7%的准确率提升和高达10.4%的利润增长。即使对于高精度的预训练TabPFN基础模型，这些收益依然存在。我们的结果表明，利用经济相关预测目标之间的一致性关系，可以同时提升预测准确性和决策价值，并且更好的统计（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出基于价差的时间层级预测框架THieF，通过联合协调小时电价与日内价差预测，在欧洲电力市场实现最高19.7%的准确率提升和10.4%的电池套利利润增长。
en_tdlr: A spread-based temporal hierarchy forecasting (THieF) framework that jointly reconciles hourly price and intraday spread forecasts improves accuracy by up to 19.7% and battery arbitrage profits by up to 10.4% in European day-ahead electricity markets.
